changeSet.author: translator
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE quota_account ( account_id varchar(64) PRIMARY KEY );
CREATE TABLE translation_request ( request_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, account_id varchar(64) NOT NULL REFERENCES quota_account(account_id), model_alias varchar(100) NOT NULL, provider varchar(100) NOT NULL, provider_model varchar(200) NOT NULL, prompt_version varchar(30) NOT NULL, source_language varchar(20) NOT NULL, target_language varchar(20) NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, lease_expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL, completed_at timestamptz, status varchar(30) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('RUNNING','SUCCEEDED','FAILED','EXPIRED')), charged_tokens bigint NOT NULL CHECK (charged_tokens >= 0), input_tokens bigint, output_tokens bigint, error_code varchar(60) ); CREATE INDEX translation_request_account_created ON translation_request(account_id, created_at); CREATE INDEX translation_request_running ON translation_request(account_id, lease_expires_at) WHERE status = 'RUNNING';
